I had an excellent experience with Dr. John this morning. He was highly professional, attentive, and made me feel completely at ease throughout the consultation. His sense of humor added a very human and comforting touch, which I truly appreciated.

What stood out the most was his impeccable English—it made communication effortless and clear, which is so important in a medical setting.

I would highly recommend Dr. John to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, approachable, and genuinely caring doctor.
